## Checklist

- [ ] `npm run check` passes (format, lint, typecheck, tests, build)
- [ ] Checked in a browser at desktop and mobile widths, or `N/A`
- [ ] No invented facts: every new data point has a source link and
      `retrievedAt`, or a clear unavailable state
- [ ] No secrets, server IPs, or credentials added
- [ ] `README.md`, `VERIFICATION.md`, `AI-USAGE.md` updated if behavior changed
